facts.business: Vidya Wires Limited manufactures winding wires and conductivity products from copper, operating plants in Anand, Gujarat.

capacity_or_capex.item: Setting up new project in subsidiary (ALCU)

key_risks: Trade barriers and tariffs (e.g., US duties on copper products)
Energy price shocks from geopolitical conflict
facts.related_party_note: Corporate guarantee of Rs 500 million issued to ICICI Bank for working capital facility of subsidiary Alcu Industries Pvt Ltd, secured by hypothecation of Alcu's fixed and current assets; personal guarantee of a director also provided.
